card.name: Start of words before approved/surgical/imaging
card.fires_on: A word or word start that comes just before a medical term, such as 'un' before 'approved', 'neuro' before 'surgical' or 'imaging', 'radi' before 'ological', and 'in' before 'the clinics'. It appears in clinical or procedural text.
